hikes.name: Sauk Mountain
hikes.blurb: Switchbacks up a meadow face of flowers to a summit over the Skagit with Baker, Shuksan and Glacier Peak.

hikes.name: Little Mountain
hikes.blurb: A forested in-town summit with a lookout over the Skagit flats and the San Juans.

hikes.name: Myrtle Lake
hikes.blurb: From Mount Higgins Trailhead, a 6.0-mile round trip to Myrtle Lake, with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sauk Lake
hikes.blurb: From Sauk Mountain Trailhead, a 5.8-mile round trip to Sauk Lake, with about 2,200 feet of climbing.
